name: isDataResidencyEnforced
definition: every active project or workspace on the AI platform is pinned to a chosen data residency region, and none uses the vendor's global (unrestricted) default.
population: the active (not archived) projects or workspaces in one organization on the AI platform, read in full
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the organization's active projects or workspaces (every page) in which each one names a regional residency value; any project left on the global default makes the answer false, and a project whose residency field is missing is not measured.
citations: OpenAI OpenAPI spec, Project.residency and PublicProjectResidency: https://github.com/openai/openai-openapi

changeLog.change: Registered so the OpenAI transform can emit it; the Anthropic transform already emitted it unregistered.

notes: OpenAI: some regions are storage-only (no _PROCESSING suffix); those pass and are reported as an additional finding, because data at rest is in region even if requests may be processed elsewhere. Whether the Anthropic implementation measures the same thing was not reviewed.
